display_name: 兔子镜小剧场 / Rabbit Mirror Theater（挨打猫 v1.4・小小维修兔 v1.58）
author: Toto
description: TEST build based on 0.33.86: Maintenance Rabbit v1.58 adds a verified fallback for forward labels placed before hidden checkbox/radio controls. It only binds when existing checked CSS has real result targets, prevents double toggles, verifies state at 0/60/260ms, and records the last actual result in diagnostics. Prompt rules, output lock, mother library, Menu QR v2.2, Feedback Cat v1.4, and the per-generation token meter are preserved.
